markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Invasive (56%)** · Unreliable input · Defer to expert
Flagged frozen-section quality, a 56% vs 44% InSitu split, and deferred margins [F10] warrant a recut or deeper levels.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | Invasive 56%, InSitu 44% [F1] (ECE 5%) | Near-even Invasive vs InSitu split |
| Conformal set | {Invasive} at α=0.10 (90% test coverage) | Single class; dataset-level guarantee only |
| Reliability / OOD | 0.44 (flagged) / 100th percentile [F6] | Out-of-distribution; suspect input quality |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree on top class | Independent backbones split on call |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Invasive [F5]; closest InSitu (86%) | Nearest match is InSitu (BACH_0160) |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.40, +0.82 contribution) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Gland / tubule formation** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.82, +0.72 contribution) [F3]; caption check inconsistent · Weak
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (region 7) · ↑ invasive · Scarce (-0.02, +0.43 contribution) [F4]; 20/20 AI spot check · Validated
- **Tumor necrosis** (regions 2, 3, 9) · ↑ invasive · Elevated (+1.64, +0.33 contribution); 3/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Nuclear size and variation** (regions 3, 5, 8) · context · Mean 38.5 µm² (0th percentile) [F7]; CV 95th percentile [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top 3 risk regions drops invasive probability above random (+0.011, 95% CI +0.002 to +0.020).
- **Concepts**: Unverified (deletion 95% CI -0.009 to +0.006 includes 0) and leans on Unreliable `normal_lobules` (0/20) and `necrosis` (3/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Out-of-distribution frozen-section artifacts drove the read; drafted orders request a recut H&E or deeper levels before margin calls.
- High-risk regions represent InSitu (44% probability; closest match `BACH_0160` is InSitu, differing in stromal invasion and lymphocytes).

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 5, 3, 8**: Highest heatmap risk (64%, 49%, 35%) with 30–48 segmented neoplastic nuclei and pleomorphic size variation.
2. **Region 10 and regions 2, 3**: Distinguish stromal invasion (region 10, Validated) from duct-confined atypia (regions 2, 3, Weak).
3. **Region 7**: Inspect why embedding concepts scored scarce lobules, tubules, and stroma here despite 4% region risk.
